scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.migration:show: npm run build:shared && cd backend && node -r ts-node/register/transpile-only -r tsconfig-paths/register ../node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:show -d ./src/typeorm-cli.datasource.ts
scripts.migration:generate: npm run build:shared && cd backend && node -r ts-node/register/transpile-only -r tsconfig-paths/register ../node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:generate ./src/infrastructure/database/migrations/$npm_config_name -d ./src/typeorm-cli.datasource.ts
scripts.migration:run: npm run build:shared && cd backend && node -r ts-node/register/transpile-only -r tsconfig-paths/register ../node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:run -d ./src/typeorm-cli.datasource.ts
scripts.migration:revert: npm run build:shared && cd backend && node -r ts-node/register/transpile-only -r tsconfig-paths/register ../node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:revert -d ./src/typeorm-cli.datasource.ts
